newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end steady to higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed steady to higher on Wednesday, particularly the nearby months, reflecting price gains on the CBOT corn market overnight, traders said.
Prices were unchanged to 110 yen higher, with the benchmark September 1997 contract up 60 yen at 17,600.
Local investors bought in early morning, encouraged by price gains on the CBOT market, traders said.
But the buying lost momentum later and the market fell back by the closing, they said.
"Everybody is watching the USDA crop report to be released tonight," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.65-1/2 per bushel at 0655 GMT, against $3.65-3/4 at Tuesday's close.
The spot September of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.30 at 0655 GMT, unchanged from Tuesday's close.
